name: nlp-refinement-cli
description: Durable-local, review-only refinement for natural-language-programming artifacts.

interface.longDescription: Guides a durable-local native TUI review, proposal, and independent assessment workflow through the separately installed NLP-refinement CLI; it validates v5 NL-artifact reviews and human-only proposals while preserving SQLite receipts. External host controllers, repair, MCP transport, and host-enforced native-subagent guarantees remain disabled.
defaultPrompt: Use $nlp-review-propose start to select artifacts for a human-only NLP-refinement workflow.
